changelog:
- input_boost: touch input boost (1.4 GHz / 60 ms default), /sys/module/input_boost/parameters/{enabled, boost_freq, boost_duration_ms}
- mm: /sys/kernel/mm/lmk_aggressive (moderate 6-level minfree tuning, dormant until enabled)
- mm: /sys/kernel/mm/swappiness (boot default 100, clamp 0-200)
- net: TCP BBR + FQ qdisc, runtime-switchable (Cubic stays default)
- block: BFQ scheduler, default I/O scheduler
- fs: dynamic fsync toggle (/sys/kernel/dyn_fsync/dyn_fsync)
- power: gaming_charge sysfs toggle
